description: This file contains a localized set of strings for the Select2 plugin in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR). It defines translations for various user interface messages used by the plugin.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when results cannot be loaded.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns the message prompting the user to delete excess characters when input exceeds maximum allowed.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns the message prompting the user to input more characters when input length is below the minimum.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message indicating more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns the message indicating the maximum number of items that can be selected.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message shown while searching for results.
